title: Hope finds a shared next step

captions.energy: Following an inspiring point of direction
captions.emotions: Feeling focused and ready to move

meaning: Inspiration supports your shared will when nurturing an idea leads to a concrete continuation and a direction you both understand.
text: A decision can grow from hope for something you would like to see together. The Star in the physical position of Manipura describes supportive action: sharing discoveries, helping an idea develop and preserving access to inspiration. The Star in energy identifies the motive, following a meaningful point of direction that has not yet become a result. The Chariot in emotions allows focus and movement towards it to be felt. One Star appears through your actions, the other explains the aim’s inward attraction, while determination connects them with something you can do next.

For example, you want to make a small collection of walks around your neighbourhood. You save interesting places, show each other photographs and choose a first route to try. **A shared direction comes alive through a step you can take together.** Covering the entire city in advance is unnecessary: walking one street is enough for a beginning. It offers material for your next decision.

The difficulty is mistaking a feeling of direction for evidence that the whole idea is ready. An overlong route and pressure to move faster then appear, supposedly to protect inspiration. Support begins to sound like urging. Hope need not become a promise of rapid results. It nourishes shared will better when it leaves room to explore and take a small step that helps you decide whether to continue.
